registers.name: CR1
registers.description: Control register 1. Bits: CEN(0), UDIS(1), URS(2), OPM(3), ARPE(7).

registers.name: SMCR
registers.description: Slave mode control register. Stored only.

registers.name: DIER
registers.description: DMA/Interrupt enable register. Bits: UIE(0), CC1IE(1), CC2IE(2), CC3IE(3), CC4IE(4).

registers.name: SR
registers.description: Status register. Bits: UIF(0), CC1IF(1), CC2IF(2), CC3IF(3), CC4IF(4). Flags are rc_w0.

registers.name: EGR
registers.description: Event generation register. Write-only. Bits: UG(0), CC1G(1), CC2G(2), CC3G(3), CC4G(4).

registers.name: CCMR1
registers.description: Capture/compare mode register 1. Bits: CC1S(1:0), CC2S(9:8). Zero means output.

registers.name: CCMR2
registers.description: Capture/compare mode register 2. Same layout for channels 3 and 4.

registers.name: DMAR
registers.description: DMA address for burst mode. Stored only.

behaviors: 16-bit upcounter increments at timer clock divided by (PSC_active + 1).
Counter runs only when CEN is set; pauses when CEN is cleared.
Overflow occurs after (ARR_active + 1) ticks; counter resets to zero and sets UIF unless UDIS is set.
Update event transfers PSC and ARR preloads to active values, unless UDIS is set.
UG write resets CNT to zero and generates update event; URS suppresses UIF but not preload transfer.
OPM clears CEN after the next update event.
Output compare match on an output-configured channel sets corresponding CCxIF flag.
CCxG write sets corresponding CCxIF flag.
Interrupt output is level-sensitive and asserted when any enabled flag is set; clearing flags lowers it.
Virtual timer deadlines are computed with muldiv64 to avoid early firing.
Unsupported accesses are logged via qemu_log_mask(GUEST_ERROR).
limitations: Input capture, PWM output, slave/external clock modes, DMA, down/center-aligned counting, and RCC clock gating are not modeled.
Only TIM2 is implemented; other timers are out of scope.
Clock frequency is fixed at 72 MHz; no RCC clock tree or APB multiplier.
Registers are 16-bit in effect; 32-bit accesses are handled as two 16-bit halves.
CCMR1/CCMR2 channel mode bits are stored but not used to alter behavior; channels are assumed output-configured.
CCER is stored but not used to enable/disable channels.
DCR and DMAR are stored only; no DMA functionality.
